title: CDS-Skill EvaluationResult and ResponsePlan
description: Output of `cds.py evaluate`. Every derived score is accompanied by the decomposition that produced it, and the routing decision names the rule that fired. `recommended_strategy` is a recommendation for the agent's next utterance, never a licence to misreport evidence.

evidence_score.description: E_score: weighted quality of the carrying evidence. Defined ONLY here. v0.1 also let evidence quality drive detection, which made the trigger and the verdict circular; here detection reads attention properties (opposition, specificity, novelty) and quality is judged once, after the trigger.

evidence_detail.description: Per-dimension weighted contributions and the member evidence ids, so one over-confident credibility rating is visible instead of averaged away.

dropped_dimensions.description: Evidence dimensions that no member evidence item rated. Dropped dimensions are removed and the remaining weights renormalised, rather than scored as zero; listing them makes that choice auditable.

adjustment_cost.description: How expensive revising the stance is for the agent. v0.1 declared this variable and never defined it; here it is an explicit weighted composite of commitment, public commitment and volition.

maintain_score.description: Defensibility of holding the stance unchanged. Function of E_score, commitment and adjustment cost, defined in references/indicators.md.

recalibrate_score.description: Reasonableness of revising. Deliberately a function of disjoint inputs from maintain_score so the two cannot be each other's restatement.

user_pressure_flag.description: True when pressure is high enough to be named as a possible driver of the chosen strategy.

resolved_profile.description: The profile actually used. For profile=mixed this is the per-event resolution, decided by reduction_tendency.

reduction_tendency.description: Only for profile=mixed: 1 means the event resolved to the motivated-reduction repertoire.

fired_rule_id.description: Id of the strategy rule that matched, or 'default'. Makes every routing decision reproducible from the config alone.

caveats.description: Things the response must not do. Populated by the engine, e.g. a denial strategy is annotated as a fidelity choice rather than an epistemic recommendation.

language_acts.description: Ordered behavioural moves the response must realise. These are the observable units Study 1 codes the produced text against.

changed.description: False for denial, trivialization and rationalization: those reduce felt tension without changing the belief, which is the signature of dissonance reduction rather than belief revision.

constraints.description: Hard limits on the response, independent of strategy. Always includes the no-fabrication and no-hidden-reasoning constraints.
